cases.title: The Elixir test suite is the largest measured step.
cases.text: The Elixir test suite took 2492 s across 10 jobs and up to 381 s in a single job. The totals do not show which job had the longest test step.
cases.advice: Profile the Elixir test suite on the coverage and Windows jobs before changing how the tests run.

cases.title: The docs build is on the critical path.
cases.text: The 50 s docs build ran on the coverage job, which finished last at 525 s. The Windows Server 2022, OTP 29.0 job finished at 494 s.
cases.advice: Try building the docs in parallel on the same OTP version. Keep the docs check required and compare both completion time and billed minutes.

cases.title: Runner waiting does not explain the finish time.
cases.text: No job is known to have waited 10 s or more for a runner. The coverage job started after 0 s.
cases.advice: Leave job dependencies unchanged and focus on the steps that run after the coverage job starts.

cases.title: Target dependency installs in the test matrix
cases.text: Dependency installation took 289 s across 19 jobs and up to 34 s in one job. The Windows tests for Node.js 23 and 24 ran for 94 s and 84 s. The install time for each of those tests is not reported.
cases.advice: Enable npm caching in the test job’s Node.js setup step. Compare cache-hit install times and the finish time of the slowest Windows test.

cases.title: Runner queueing was not an evident bottleneck
cases.text: No job is known to have waited 10 s or more for a runner.
cases.advice: Focus on job execution time before changing runner capacity.

cases.title: Coverage needs the test artifacts
cases.text: Coverage started after 97 s and ran for the final 24 s of the 121 s run. It waits for the tests and consumes their uploaded coverage reports.
cases.advice: Keep the dependency on the test matrix so coverage can download and merge its reports.

cases.title: The macOS runner queue dominated the wait.
cases.text: The last macOS job waited 218 s for a runner, then ran for 107 s. Its runner wait was the largest part of the 350 s run.
cases.advice: Check macOS runner availability and whether older runs are competing for runners.

cases.title: Tests do not need lint to finish first.
cases.text: The test matrix waits for lint but consumes no lint outputs or artifacts. Removing that dependency lets tests request runners earlier without changing what they run.
cases.advice: Let tests queue alongside lint, then compare completion times across successful runs.
